name: Gudanar da Ayyuka ta Hanyar Agile
objectives: Idan aka ba ku bayanin wani aiki, bayyana yadda Agile ke gudanar da aiki a gajerun zagaye, da lokacin da waterfall ya fi dacewa, da kalmominku, da misali ɗaya na kowanne
Idan aka ba ku ƙaramar ƙungiyar Scrum, ambaci alhaki uku na Scrum, abubuwa (events) biyar da kayayyakin aiki (artifacts) uku, kuna samun aƙalla 9 cikin 11 daidai
Don aiki na gaske na mako biyu zuwa shida, rubuta backlog na aƙalla user story takwas tare da ma'aunin kammalawa, bisa muhimmanci, kowane story yana bin tsarin "A matsayina na..., ina so... domin..."

Idan kuna da backlog ɗinku da sa'o'in da kuke da su a zahiri, tsara sprint na mako ɗaya da burin sprint na jimla ɗaya da ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka, ta yadda aikin da aka tsara ya dace da lokacin da kuke da shi
A lokacin sprint ɗinku, bin diddigin aikin a allon ayyuka mai iyakar WIP da ganawar yau da kullum ta minti 15, kuna motsa kowane kati yayin da aikin ke tafiya
A ƙarshen sprint ɗinku, yin bitar sprint da retrospective na Keep, Stop, Try, da ƙara gyara ɗaya a sprint na gaba, da rubuta ra'ayoyin mutane a cikin backlog

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Tsara aiki ta hanyar Agile

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Mene ne Agile, da yadda ya bambanta da babban tsari
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Bayyana da kalmominku yadda Agile ke gudanar da aiki a gajerun zagaye.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku bayanin wani aiki, za ku iya bayyana yadda Agile ke gudanar da aiki a gajerun zagaye, da lokacin da waterfall ya fi dacewa, da kalmominku, da misali ɗaya na kowanne.
A aikin gargajiya ko na "waterfall", kuna tsara komai tun farko, sannan ku gina shi, sannan ku gwada shi, sannan ku miƙa shi a ƙarshe. Wannan yana aiki idan aikin sananne ne, kamar zuba harsashin gini. Yana lalacewa idan buƙatu suka canja a tsakiyar aiki.
Agile yana miƙa aiki a gajerun zagaye, sau da yawa mako ɗaya zuwa huɗu. Kowane zagaye yana samar da abin da za a iya amfani da shi, ƙungiyar tana nuna shi ga mutanen da aka yi dominsu, kuma ana gyara tsarin bisa abin da suka faɗa. Agile Manifesto (2001) ya faɗa a sauƙaƙe: sakamako mai aiki da karɓar canji sun fi muhimmanci fiye da bin tsari ɗaya ba tare da canji ba.
Scrum da Kanban su ne hanyoyi biyu da aka fi amfani da su wajen yin Agile. Scrum yana amfani da zagaye masu tsayin lokaci ɗaya da ake kira sprint. Kanban yana amfani da allo da tafiyar aiki a hankali, tare da iyaka kan yawan aikin da ake yi a lokaci ɗaya. Kuna iya amfani da dabaru daga duka biyun.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Agile: hanyar gudanar da ayyuka a gajerun zagaye, da dubawa da canje-canje akai-akai.
- Waterfall: hanyar gudanar da ayyuka inda ake gama kowane mataki kafin a fara na gaba.
- Scrum: hanyar Agile da ke aiki a zagaye masu tsayin lokaci ɗaya da ake kira sprint.
- Kanban: hanyar Agile da ke amfani da allo kuma tana iyakance yawan aikin da ake yi a lokaci ɗaya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Manifesto for Agile Software Development
- The Scrum Guide (2020)
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi aiki ɗaya na gaske da kuke son gamawa cikin mako biyu zuwa shida masu zuwa. Ku rubuta jimla ɗaya da ke bayanin sa, da jimla ɗaya game da waɗanda aka yi shi dominsu.
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana yadda Agile ya bambanta da babban tsari na farko, da ambaton Scrum da Kanban.

options: Tsari ɗaya na mako huɗu
Wani nau'in user story
Jarabawar takardar shaida
Hanyar yin Agile da allo da iyaka kan aikin da ake yi
check.why: Kanban yana amfani da allo da tafiyar aiki a hankali, tare da iyaka kan yawan aikin da ake yi.

check.q: Ƙungiyarku ta tsofaffin sojoji tana gina sabon shafin intanet, kuma 'yan ƙungiyar suna ta canja abin da suke so. Wace hanya ce ta dace?
options: Waterfall: tsara duka tun farko ku miƙa a ƙarshe
Agile: miƙa a gajerun zagaye ku gyara bayan kowanne
Babu tsari kwata-kwata
Jira har kowa ya yarda da komai
check.why: Agile ya dace da aikin da buƙatunsa ke canjawa, domin ana nuna kowane zagaye kuma ana gyara tsarin.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Ayyuka, abubuwa da kayayyakin aiki a Scrum
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Ambaci wanda ke yin me a Scrum, da abubuwa biyar da sprint ke amfani da su.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku ƙaramar ƙungiyar Scrum, za ku iya ambaci alhaki uku na Scrum, abubuwa (events) biyar da kayayyakin aiki (artifacts) uku, kuna samun aƙalla 9 cikin 11 daidai.
Scrum Guide (bugun 2020) ya ambaci alhaki uku. Product Owner (mai kula da samfur) yana yanke abin da ya fi muhimmanci kuma yana tsara jerin aiki. Developers (masu aiwatarwa) su ne mutanen da ke yin aikin, na kowane iri, ba software kaɗai ba. Scrum Master yana taimaka wa ƙungiyar ta bi Scrum kuma yana cire abubuwan da ke hana aiki.
Akwai abubuwa (events) biyar. Sprint shi ne ma'ajin duka, wata ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka. Sprint Planning yana saita burin sprint kuma yana zaɓar aikin. Daily Scrum duba ne na minti 15 kan ci gaba zuwa ga burin. Sprint Review yana nuna sakamakon ga mutanen da aka yi aikin dominsu. Sprint Retrospective yana duba yadda ƙungiyar ta yi aiki kuma yana zaɓar gyare-gyare.
Akwai kayayyakin aiki (artifacts) uku: Product Backlog (duk aikin, bisa tsari), Sprint Backlog (aikin da aka zaɓa don wannan sprint) da Increment (sakamako mai amfani). A ƙaramin aiki, mutum ɗaya yana iya riƙe matsayi fiye da ɗaya. Wannan ba laifi ba ne, muddin an yi kowane aiki.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Product Owner: mutumin da ke yanke wane aiki ne ya fi muhimmanci kuma yana tsara backlog.
- Scrum Master: mutumin da ke taimaka wa ƙungiyar ta yi amfani da Scrum da kyau kuma yana cire abubuwan da ke hana aiki.
- Increment: sakamako mai amfani da sprint ke samarwa.
- Retrospective: taro a ƙarshen sprint game da yadda ƙungiyar ta yi aiki; yana kama da bitar bayan aiki (after-action review).
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- The Scrum Guide (2020)
Gwada yanzu: Don aikinku, ku rubuta wanda zai zama Product Owner, Scrum Master da Developers. Idan ku kaɗai ne, ku rubuta wace hula za ku sa a kowane abu (event).
Yanzu za ku iya ambaci alhaki uku na Scrum, abubuwa biyar da kayayyakin aiki uku, da raba su a aikinku.

options: Sakamako mai amfani da sprint ya samar
Jerin duk aikin
Taron yau da kullum
Rahoton Scrum Master
check.why: Increment shi ne sakamako mai amfani; Product Backlog shi ne jerin duk aikin.

check.q: Ku kaɗai ne a wani ƙaramin aiki. Me za ku yi game da matsayin Scrum?
options: Ku tsaya, domin Scrum yana buƙatar aƙalla mutum uku
Ku fara ɗaukar Scrum Master aiki
Ku riƙe matsayi fiye da ɗaya ku tabbata an yi kowane aiki
Ku tsallake aikin Product Owner
check.why: A ƙaramin aiki mutum ɗaya yana iya riƙe matsayi fiye da ɗaya, muddin an yi kowane aiki.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Rubuta user story da gina backlog
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Mayar da aiki jerin user story bisa muhimmanci, kowanne da layin kammalawa a sarari.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don aiki na gaske na mako biyu zuwa shida, za ku iya rubuta backlog na aƙalla user story takwas tare da ma'aunin kammalawa, bisa muhimmanci, kowane story yana bin tsarin "A matsayina na..., ina so... domin...".
User story yana bayanin wani yanki na aiki daga ra'ayin mutumin da yake taimaka wa: "A matsayina na [irin mutum], ina so [wani abu] domin [dalili]." Misali: "A matsayina na mai ɗaukar ma'aikata, ina so takardar bayanin aiki (résumé) mai shafi ɗaya domin in ga ƙwarewar mai nema da sauri."
Kowane story yana buƙatar ma'aunin kammalawa (acceptance criteria): bincike biyu ko uku da ke faɗin lokacin da ya kammala. Don story na résumé: ya isa shafi ɗaya, ya lissafa sakamako uku da za a iya aunawa, babu kuskuren rubutu. Layukan kammalawa a sarari suna hana jayayya daga baya.
Ku jera story ɗin bisa tsari: mafi daraja da mafi gaggawa a sama. Mataimakin AI kamar ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot ko Google Gemini zai iya taimaka muku rubuta daftarin story daga bayanin aiki, amma ku ne kuke yanke tsarin, kuma ku duba cewa kowane story aiki ne na gaske.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku lissafa duk abin da aikin ke buƙata, abu ɗaya a kowane layi.
- Ku sake rubuta kowane abu a matsayin "A matsayina na..., ina so... domin...".
- Ku ƙara ma'aunin kammalawa biyu ko uku ga kowanne.
- Ku raba duk story da ya yi girma sosai da ba za a gama shi a sprint ɗaya ba.
- Ku jera story ɗin bisa muhimmanci, daga sama zuwa ƙasa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- User story: gajeren bayanin aiki daga ra'ayin mutumin da yake taimaka wa.
- Acceptance criteria (ma'aunin kammalawa): binciken da ke faɗin cewa story ya kammala.
- Backlog: jerin duk aikin aiki, bisa tsari.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta aƙalla user story takwas don aikinku, kowanne da ma'aunin kammalawa, ku jera su bisa muhimmanci. Kuna iya tambayar mataimakin AI: "Ka mayar da wannan aikin user story tare da acceptance criteria" sannan ku gyara abin da ya bayar.
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta user story tare da ma'aunin kammalawa, da jera su a cikin backlog.

check.q: Me sashen "domin" na user story yake bayarwa?
options: Ranar ƙarshe
Mutumin da ke yin aikin
Dalilin da yasa aikin yake da muhimmanci
Kuɗin aikin
check.why: "Domin" yana faɗin dalili ko amfanin aikin ga mutumin da story ɗin ke taimaka wa.

check.q: Mataimakin AI ya rubuta story don taron al'ummarku. Ɗaya yana cewa "Tsara taron gaba ɗaya". Me za ku yi?
options: Ku raba shi zuwa ƙananan story da za su dace da sprint ɗaya
Ku bar shi a matsayin story na farko
Ku goge duk story ɗin AI
Ku ƙara shi a kowane sprint
check.why: Story da ya yi girma sosai don sprint ɗaya ya kamata a raba shi zuwa ƙananan sassa.

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Tsara sprint da buri a sarari
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Tsara sprint na mako ɗaya ko biyu da burin sprint da adadin aiki da ya dace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kuna da backlog ɗinku da sa'o'in da kuke da su a zahiri, za ku iya tsara sprint na mako ɗaya da burin sprint na jimla ɗaya da ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka, ta yadda aikin da aka tsara ya dace da lokacin da kuke da shi.
Sprint Planning yana amsa tambayoyi uku: me yasa wannan sprint yake da daraja (burin sprint), me za a iya yi (wane story), da yaya za a yi shi (ayyukan).
Burin sprint jimla ɗaya ce, kamar manufar kwamanda (commander's intent): "Kafin Juma'a, ina da résumé da ya kammala, kuma na aika takardun neman aiki biyar da aka dace da kowane aiki." Idan tsare-tsare suka canja a tsakiya, burin yana faɗa wa kowa abin da har yanzu yake da muhimmanci.
Ku ɗauki story daga saman backlog har lokacin ƙungiyar ya cika, kuma ku bar ɗan sarari. Sababbin ƙungiyoyi kusan koyaushe suna tsara aiki fiye da kima. Ku raba kowane story zuwa ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku yanke tsawon sprint (mako ɗaya ko biyu yana da kyau ga masu farawa).
- Ku rubuta burin sprint na jimla ɗaya.
- Ku ɗauko story daga saman backlog da ke taimaka wa burin.
- Ku raba kowane story zuwa ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka.
- Ku kwatanta jimillar da sa'o'in da kuke da su a zahiri, ku rage idan ya cancanta.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Burin sprint (sprint goal): jimla ɗaya da ke faɗin abin da ake son sprint ya cimma.
- Capacity (ƙarfin aiki): yawan lokacin da ƙungiyar take da shi a zahiri a lokacin sprint.
Gwada yanzu: Ku tsara sprint na mako ɗaya don aikinku: ku rubuta burin sprint, ku zaɓi story, ku raba su zuwa ayyuka, sannan ku kwatanta su da sa'o'in da kuke da su a zahiri a wannan makon.
Yanzu za ku iya tsara sprint da buri, story da aka zaɓa da ayyukan da suka dace da lokacinku na gaske.

check.q: Har tsawon wane lokaci ya kamata aiki ɗaya a tsarin sprint ya ɗauka?
options: Sprint gaba ɗaya
Kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da haka
Aƙalla mako ɗaya
Wata ɗaya
check.why: Raba story zuwa ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa yana sauƙaƙa bin diddigin ci gaba.

check.q: A tsakiyar sprint, tsare-tsare sun canja. Me ke faɗa wa ƙungiyar abin da har yanzu yake da muhimmanci?
options: Katin da ya fi daɗewa a allo
Duk wanda ya fi ɗaga murya
Retrospective na bara
Burin sprint
check.why: Kamar manufar kwamanda, burin sprint yana faɗin abin da har yanzu yake da muhimmanci idan tsare-tsare suka canja.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Gudanar da aiki a allon ayyuka
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Kafa allon ayyuka ku yi amfani da ganawar yau da kullum don aiki ya ci gaba da tafiya.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A lokacin sprint ɗinku, za ku iya bin diddigin aikin a allon ayyuka mai iyakar WIP da ganawar yau da kullum ta minti 15, kuna motsa kowane kati yayin da aikin ke tafiya.
Allon ayyuka (task board) yana nuna aiki a layuka (columns): To Do (za a yi), In Progress (ana yi) da Done (an gama). Kowane aiki kati ne da ke motsawa zuwa dama yayin da aikin ke tafiya. Kuna iya amfani da takardun manne a bango, maƙunshi (spreadsheet), ko kayan allo kyauta kamar Trello, Microsoft Planner ko GitHub Projects.
Kanban yana ƙara iyakar aikin da ake yi (WIP limit): misali, kada katuna fiye da biyu su kasance a In Progress ga kowane mutum. Gama aiki ya fi fara sabon aiki.
Daily Scrum minti 15 ne. Kowane mutum yana faɗin ci gabansa zuwa ga burin sprint, abin da zai yi a gaba, da duk abin da ke hana shi aiki (blocker). Ana warware abubuwan da ke hana aiki bayan taron, ba a lokacin sa ba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku yi layuka uku: To Do, In Progress, Done.
- Ku ƙara kati ɗaya ga kowane aiki daga tsarin sprint ɗinku.
- Ku saita iyakar WIP, kamar katuna biyu a In Progress.
- Kowace rana, ku motsa katuna ku yi ganawa ta minti 15.
- Ku rubuta abubuwan da ke hana aiki da wanda zai cire su.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Allon ayyuka (task board): allo mai layuka da ke nuna inda kowane aiki yake.
- Iyakar WIP (WIP limit): iyaka kan ayyuka nawa za a iya yi a lokaci ɗaya. WIP gajartawar work in progress ce (aikin da ake yi).
- Blocker (cikas): duk abin da ke hana aiki ci gaba.
Gwada yanzu: Ku gina allon ayyuka don sprint ɗinku mai layuka uku da kati ɗaya ga kowane aiki. Ku saita iyakar WIP. A kwanaki uku masu zuwa, ku motsa katunan ku rubuta ganawar yau da kullum ta layi biyu.
Yanzu za ku iya gudanar da sprint a allon ayyuka mai iyakar WIP da gajeriyar ganawar yau da kullum.

check.q: Waɗanne abubuwa uku ne kowane mutum ke faɗa a Daily Scrum?
options: Albashinsa, matsayinsa da sa'o'insa
Kowane ɗan bayani na kowane aiki
Ra'ayinsa game da Product Owner
Ci gaba zuwa ga burin, abin da ke gaba da duk wani cikas
check.why: Daily Scrum gajeren duba ne kan ci gaba zuwa ga burin sprint, matakai na gaba da cikas.

check.q: Kun gama wani aiki. Me za ku yi da katinsa?
options: Ku bar shi a In Progress
Ku motsa shi zuwa Done
Ku jefar da shi kafin kowa ya gani
Ku mayar da shi To Do
check.why: Katuna suna motsawa zuwa dama yayin da aiki ke tafiya, don haka aikin da aka gama yana zuwa Done.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Rufe sprint: bita da retrospective
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Yin bitar sprint da retrospective, da mayar da su canji ɗaya a sprint na gaba.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A ƙarshen sprint ɗinku, za ku iya yin bitar sprint da retrospective na Keep, Stop, Try, da ƙara gyara ɗaya a sprint na gaba, da rubuta ra'ayoyin mutane a cikin backlog.
Sprint Review yana nuna aikin da aka gama ga mutanen da aka yi shi dominsu kuma yana tambayar ra'ayinsu. Ku nuna aikin da ya cika ma'aunin kammalawarsa kaɗai. Ra'ayoyinsu suna komawa cikin backlog.
Sprint Retrospective game da yadda kuka yi aiki ne, ba abin da kuka gina ba. Yana aiki kamar bitar bayan aiki (after-action review): me ya kamata ya faru, me ya faru, me yasa, da me za a yi daban. Tsari mai sauƙi shi ne Keep, Stop, Try (Ci gaba, Daina, Gwada).
Ku zaɓi gyara ɗaya ku saka shi a sprint na gaba a matsayin aiki na gaske. Retrospective da bai canja komai ba taro ne kawai. Takardun shaida na Agile, kamar Certified ScrumMaster daga Scrum Alliance ko Professional Scrum Master daga Scrum.org, za su iya zuwa daga baya; ku duba shafukansu don sharuɗɗa da kuɗaɗe na yanzu.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku lissafa abin da aka gama kuma ya cika ma'aunin kammalawarsa.
- Ku nuna shi ga mutanen da aka yi shi dominsu ku rubuta ra'ayoyinsu.
- Ku ƙara ra'ayoyin a cikin backlog.
- Ku yi retrospective na Keep / Stop / Try.
- Ku saka gyara ɗaya a sprint na gaba.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Sprint Review: taro don nuna aikin da aka gama da samun ra'ayoyi.
- Bitar bayan aiki (after-action review): bitar soja kan abin da aka tsara, abin da ya faru da abin da za a canja.
- Keep / Stop / Try: tsari mai sauƙi na retrospective: abin da za a ci gaba da shi, abin da za a daina, abin da za a gwada.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Scrum Alliance: Certified ScrumMaster
- Scrum.org assessments
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku gama sprint ɗinku na mako ɗaya. Ku rubuta gajeren bitar sprint (abin da aka gama, wanda ya gani, abin da suka faɗa) da retrospective na Keep / Stop / Try, sannan ku ƙara gyara ɗaya a sprint na gaba.
Yanzu za ku iya rufe sprint da bita da retrospective, da ɗaukar gyara ɗaya zuwa sprint na gaba.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Backlog na user story Story ƙasa da takwas, ko an rubuta abubuwa a matsayin ayyuka kawai ba tare da "domin" ba. Aƙalla story takwas a cikin tsarin, kowanne da ma'aunin kammalawa biyu ko uku, bisa muhimmanci. An raba manyan story, kuma mai koyo zai iya bayyana dalilin da yasa story na farko yake a sama. Tsarin sprint Babu burin sprint, ko aikin ya fi lokacin da ake da shi. Burin sprint na jimla ɗaya, story daga saman backlog, da ayyuka na kwana ɗaya ko ƙasa da suka dace da sa'o'in. Ya bar ɗan sarari kuma ya faɗi abin da za a fara cirewa. Allon ayyuka An kafa allon amma ba a motsa katuna a cikin makon ba. Layukan To Do, In Progress da Done, iyakar WIP, da katunan da ake motsawa kowace rana. An rubuta cikas tare da wanda ya cire su. Bita da retrospective Babu bitar ko retrospective. Rubutaccen bita da aka ƙara ra'ayoyinsa a backlog, kuma an lissafa Keep, Stop da Try. Gyara ɗaya ya riga ya zama aiki a sprint na gaba. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Retrospective ya fi kama da wace al'adar soja?
options: Bitar bayan aiki (after-action review)
Bikin canjin kwamanda
Neman kayan aiki
Duba kayan sarki (uniform)
check.why: Kamar bitar bayan aiki, yana tambayar me aka tsara, me ya faru, me yasa, da me za a canja.

check.q: Ƙungiyarku ta lissafa abubuwa biyar da za a gwada a sprint na gaba. Me ke sa retrospective ya yi amfani?
options: Ku gwada duka biyar a lokaci ɗaya
Ku rubuta su ku manta da su
Ku zaɓi ɗaya ku ƙara shi a sprint na gaba a matsayin aiki na gaske
Ku yi wani taro don tattauna su
check.why: Gyara ɗaya da aka mayar aiki na gaske shi ne ke canja yadda ƙungiyar ke aiki.
